text:
Maya: FYI ran into a pretty bad DX/API interaction while testing the new JS SDK throttler. When the server returns sustained 429s the client retry loop + default concurrency causes huge bursts and pagination skips items. Repro steps below.

Lin: ugh. is this the new retry middleware or the old one?

Maya: new one. defaultRetry=3, exponential backoff but we don't respect server Retry-After and we allow 20 concurrent requests by default in paginated fetchers. so when a page hits 429 the backoff schedule for 20 inflight requests lines up and we hammer again.

Oscar: that explains the spike I saw in the SRE dashboard earlier. top burst at 11:22pm correlated with Maya's test. server returned 429 + no Retry-After header sometimes.

Lin: hmm. SDK parity concern — the Python client has a built-in token-bucket limiter but JS didn't get it yet. We should add a client-side concurrency cap + optional token-bucket. Also honor Retry-After header if present.

Maya: quick curl repro (single-threaded shows problem when concurrency enabled):

```
# simulate paginated seq calls
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?page=$((i%5))" &
done
wait
```

On a local mock that returns intermittent 429s the JS SDK ends up skipping page 3 in ~20% of runs because our pagination helper treats a 429 as an unrecoverable error after internal retries.

Alex: can we fix in two parts: 1) stop skipping pages — treat 429 as retryable if we haven't exhausted max_retries and preserve page cursor/state; 2) add a simple client-side limiter (concurrency + bucket) and honor Retry-After. Both should be small patches.

Lin: agreed. I'll sketch an API for JS: new options { maxConcurrency: number, rateLimit: { tokensPerSecond }, honorRetryAfter: boolean }. default maxConcurrency: 6 (not 20) to match Python. Backwards compatible.

Maya: also propose sample-app update in dev-examples so onboarding users don't hit this. The sample app currently shows naive parallel pagination which makes this a footgun.

Oscar: from infra side we'll try to add a 429 Retry-After header where feasible. but client should still behave.

Lin: creating PR with tests and a tiny in-memory token bucket + queue. will post link when ready. cc @Maya for test cases.

ci-bot: build started for lin/sdk-js-429-backpressure (sha: abc123)

Maya: will add flaky repro to e2e matrix. also filing a small DX bug for the sample app: https://redwood-internal/issues/5234

Alex: prioritize for next sprint, please. this hits PLG onboarding.

Maya: thanks — assigning myself to the sample-app fix and Lin to the SDK limiter. will follow up with PR reviews. :thumbsup:

Lin: thanks. ping me if you want the Python token-bucket impl ported over.

Oscar: noted for SRE alerting: treat sustained 429 + ClientIP spikes as potential client-side backpressure bug.

Maya: closing loop here for now. I'll paste a short README snippet for sample-app explaining recommended concurrency + how to set honorRetryAfter.

Alex: :eyes: looking forward to the patch.
